feature: frozen actor camera encoder output after the trained adapter
target: segmentation-derived cube centroid in the 224x224 RGB image
target_rationale: The wrist camera and robot pose are randomized. Image-plane cube position is identifiable from RGB alone; absolute world XY is not without proprioception.
visibility: Ground-truth MuJoCo segmentation defines visibility. Fully occluded samples are excluded from fitting and scoring, and visibility rates are reported.
cross_validation: five-fold leave-one-seed-out; next seed validates ridge alpha; remaining three seeds fit; final fold refits on all four non-test seeds
uncertainty: 95% bootstrap over five held-out seed means, with wood and plaster paired within each seed
baseline: fold-specific mean image centroid from the four non-test seeds
superseded_analysis: The legacy world-XY probe was intentionally not retained; this report uses the identifiable image-plane centroid target.
